decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - Reason for Approval

The proposed garage conversion, first floor side extension and roof extension, by way of their position, size, scale and appearance, respect the appearance of the area and would not harm neighbours living conditions or the free flow and safety of traffic and availability of on street parking.  The proposal therefore complies with Adopted UDP policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), H.4.1 (Housing standards and Guidelines), H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) and T.1.4 (Car and Cycle Parking and Servicing Facilities for Developments) of The London Borough of Hounslow UDP, Adopted December 2003; and the Council's Residential Extension Guidelines.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 5 - No flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the northern sidewall of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
description: Conversion of garage to habitable room, erection of 1st floor side extension and rear roof extension to existing dwellinghouse.
